test_case.test_name: MP1/SMU correctable error and firmware-service continuity
test_case.purpose: For each approved MP1/socket target, inject one authoritative CE, prove exactly one fresh MP1-specific event without reset/UCE escalation, and retain SMU telemetry, thermal, power and clock control.
required_package: Pinned MP1-specific script or signed proof of the shared GMI3 path
MP1-specific CE count/source and no-reset oracle
SMU service thresholds, recovery and exact debug/threshold/BIOS/HDT rollback
test_case.test_command: Do not run the mismatched script or tuple. After reconciliation, baseline MP1 logs/sensors/controls, execute one approved CE once on one mapped socket, correlate exactly one source-specific CE and no reset/UCE, then restore state and verify firmware telemetry/control under a bounded workload.
test_case.expected_result: Exactly one fresh MP1 CE occurs at the intended index within timeout; no UCE/BERT/reset branch is entered; SMU sensors, clock/power/thermal control and host workload remain within approved limits; all settings return to baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until script and tuple semantics are authoritative. Tool PASS, generic corrected text, wrong script/source, reset/UCE, sensor/control loss, firmware timeout or incomplete restoration fails.
safety_gate: Dedicated thermally stable SUT with independent console.
No execution of a mismatched or unpinned script.
One MP1 CE once; abort on reset, UCE, sensor loss or power/thermal anomaly.
No automatic retry; preserve firmware evidence.
expected_evidence: Pinned/reconciled script and vendor tuple contract
Fresh MP1-specific CE with zero UCE/reset delta
test_case.recovery: Restore debug, threshold, BIOS/HDT and SMU state; cover sensor/control loss, firmware timeout, UCE escalation and unexpected reset via approved OOB recovery. Execution remains blocked until approved.
